memory_interpretation.scope: Separate fresh process RSS with warm/uncontrolled OS page cache; resident includes R-ablation and direct loads comparison arrays. This is not OS-wide RAM, physical SSD, cold-cache speed, GPU or model-quality qualification.

packaging_review.mode: Read-only source review; no packaging execution or model rerun
observed_controls: CI source identity binds the captured exact commit and its immutable tree.
CI child starts a new session; timeout kills the process group before collecting bounded known evidence.
Artifact staging allows known logs, receipts and arrays with per-file and total retained-byte limits.
Kit reads all 50 original locked assets, uses actual descriptor size and full payload hashes, and checks file stamps around copying.
Kit rejects overwrite, rereads every written ZIP member, and compares complete hashes and member paths.
Kit captures source tree from the supplied immutable source commit and rechecks HEAD and tracked cleanliness before publication.
packaging_review.remaining_scope: These are acquisition and packaging controls for a pinned local candidate. This source review does not claim a completed clean CI model replay or a completed final offline kit build.
packaging_review.repaired_review_finding: Previously tree was resolved from moving HEAD after long copying, so a changed checkout could mismatch recorded commit and tree. Current source captures the immutable supplied commit tree and refuses a changed source before publication.
packaging_review.status: No remaining concrete blocker identified in the reviewed source
